purpose: Review useful B direct/request-bound tradeoffs before H scores; evaluation-only, never a training target

cases.caption: A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.
cases.observation: Both retain a balloon and predominantly translate/bob. Neither sampled sequence establishes sustained inflation/stretching. The normal SA gain does not by itself prove the requested process is solved.

cases.caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
cases.observation: Direct-read roller body disappears after frame22, leaving a horizontal rail/handle and local rectangular defect. Normal retains a roller-like body but it rotates/deforms and has duplicate/contact defects later. Higher direct PC does not represent better roller identity or reliable coating progress. Shared first image is already largely green.

interpretation: Direct physical read has measured aggregate PC benefit, but its4.000 fixed16 score is not proof of good actual videos. H must retain physical benefit and improve entity/process execution; query-response efficacy remains unproven until H evaluation.
scope: Four existing sampled-frame panels only, not an exhaustive video or aggregate quality assessment; no new scoring or generation
